en.title: Italian Army CH-47 crashes during training in Bosnia; EUFOR reports no civilian casualties
en.summary: An Italian Army CH-47 Chinook assigned to EUFOR crashed during a training flight near Brčko in northern Bosnia on October 29, killing and injuring people on board; EUFOR said there were no civilian casualties and no damage to ground infrastructure, and the cause is under investigation.
body: An Italian Army CH-47 Chinook helicopter assigned to the European Union Force (EUFOR) crashed during a training flight near the Gorice area by Brčko in northern Bosnia-Herzegovina on October 29, killing and injuring people on board. EUFOR confirmed the crash caused no damage to infrastructure, buildings or civilian vehicles, and no civilian casualties.

The helicopter was conducting a routine training flight in the Brčko region, about 180 kilometres north of the capital Sarajevo, when the accident occurred. The cause has not yet been determined, and EUFOR and the Italian Ministry of Defence are conducting a comprehensive investigation, with further information to be released once verification is complete.

Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni expressed condolences to the victims and their families. EUFOR took over the mission in Bosnia-Herzegovina from NATO in 2004 and comprises 1,000 to 1,500 personnel operating under a United Nations Security Council mandate to maintain security and oversee implementation of the Dayton Peace Agreement.

zh.title: 義大利陸軍CH-47波士尼亞訓練中墮毀：EUFOR稱無平民傷亡、事故原因調查中
zh.summary: 10月29日，隸屬EUFOR的義大利陸軍CH-47契努克直升機在波士尼亞北部布爾奇科附近訓練飛行時墮毀，造成機上人員死傷；EUFOR確認未造成平民傷亡與地面設施損害，事故原因仍在調查中。
body: 10月29日，一架隸屬歐盟駐波士尼亞維和部隊（EUFOR）的義大利陸軍CH-47契努克直升機，在波士尼亞北部布爾奇科市附近戈里济地區進行訓練飛行時墮毀，造成機上人員死傷。EUFOR確認，事故未造成基礎設施、建築或民用車輛損害，也沒有平民傷亡。
事故發生在首都塞拉耶佛以北約180公里的布爾奇科地區，當時直升機正在執行例行訓練飛行。事故原因尚未確定，EUFOR與義大利國防部正在進行全面調查，並表示將在查證完成後適時公布進一步資訊。
義大利總理梅洛尼已對罹難者與家屬表達哀悼。EUFOR自2004年起接替北約在波士尼亞的任務，現有約1000至1500名人員，依聯合國安理會授權維持治安並監督岱頓和平協議的執行。
